title: Slash theme
description: A hushed, premium business-bank theme: a cool near-black page, dark slate cards with hairline borders and 10px corners, white ink that doubles as the action colour (white pills), cool grey secondary text, and one warm note of brushed gold and amber glow. Headings in a high-contrast display serif with italic accents, everything else in Inter. The light sibling is ivory paper with the same serif and a deeper gold.
notes: primary is white in dark (white pill buttons); highlight = brushed gold for figures, glow = amber for warm light and article categories
card is the slate card surface; muted/secondary/accent are progressively lighter slates used for chips, toggles and hover fills
